description: This file defines the DrugOrderValidator class responsible for validating DrugOrder objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes validation logic for ensuring fields are set correctly, concepts are valid, and business rules for drug ordering are enforced.

classes.name: DrugOrderValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the DrugOrder class, ensuring correctness of drug order data before processing.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of the given class type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the DrugOrder object, checking field presence, business rules, and concept validity.

methods.name: validateForRequireDrug
methods.description: Validates the presence of a drug or non-coded drug concept based on global properties.

methods.name: validateFieldsForOutpatientCareSettingType
methods.description: Validates additional fields related to outpatient care setting for the drug order.

methods.name: validatePairedFields
methods.description: Ensures that certain fields like dose, quantity, and duration are paired properly with their units.

methods.name: validateUnitsAreAmongAllowedConcepts
methods.description: Confirms that units used for dose, quantity, and duration are among allowed concepts.
